verified_observations.observation: Verified the distinct 2021 peer-reviewed work DOI 10.3389/fnut.2020.600470, PMID 33598474, PMCID PMC7882711; publisher exact sections expose study locale/design/procedures, data availability, ethics/consent statement, and CC BY rights.

Verified bounded study provenance: selected villages in Murhu and Torpa blocks, Khunti district; nine FGDs and six key-informant interviews; data collection June 2019-January 2020; local Mundari-fluent field workers supported qualitative enquiries. These are methodological facts, not universal cultural claims.

Verified reported institutional ethics approvals and participant consent procedures. This was not interpreted as participant consent for MLHKP redistribution or culturally unrestricted secondary reuse.

Observed a CC BY 4.0 supplementary-data manifestation associated with the 2021 article. Direct fetch failed in this runtime; bytes/checksum and item-level cultural-access review remain pending, so participant-derived food-list content was not ingested.
Reconfirmed Bhaduri Mundari-English Dictionary manifestations and pagination metadata; no duplicate work identity created and no restricted/preview lexical content promoted.
